Manual API 30+ acceptance:
1. Start the worker scenario.
2. Tap Trigger Fatal ANR and wait until Android shows the ANR dialog; choose Close app.
3. Return here and start two fresh recovery processes concurrently.
4. Expect one provider call, one emitted payload, a matching system/provider timestamp, and payload sessionId/viewId matching the expected old context.
5. Wait 12 seconds and repeat step 3, or relaunch the App; both counts must remain one.
ApplicationExitInfo acceptance requires Android API 30 or above.
Preparing and persisting the worker RUM View…
Worker View was not persisted. Return and retry before triggering ANR.
Tap the button and wait until Android shows the ANR dialog. Choose Close app, then start the two concurrent recovery processes from the controller page.
